description: Pattern-based prevention rules for ctrl-alt-defeat — Godot 4 card game prototype (15 files, Sprint 5/6)

rules.name: Insufficient card count for gameplay testing
rules.message: Card game has fewer than 20 unique cards — insufficient for deck building and gameplay testing
rules.suggestion: Add more card definitions as Resource files; minimum 20 cards before gameplay testing milestone

rules.name: Hardcoded enemy stats instead of Resource files
rules.message: Hardcoded enemy stat — prototype should use data-driven Resource files for easy expansion
rules.suggestion: Create EnemyStats resource files: var stats: EnemyStats = preload('res://resources/enemies/goblin.tres')

rules.name: Single hardcoded combat encounter
rules.message: Single hardcoded combat encounter — needs encounter manager for multiple scenarios
rules.suggestion: Create an EncounterManager that loads encounters from Resource files

rules.name: Missing SceneManager autoload
rules.message: Direct scene change without SceneManager — no progression tracking or transition management
rules.suggestion: Create SceneManager autoload with change_scene_with_transition() and progression tracking

rules.name: combat_end signal without reward handler
rules.message: Combat end signal has no reward handler — victories give no loot, XP, or currency
rules.suggestion: Connect combat_end signal to a reward handler: combat_end.connect(_on_combat_end_rewards)

rules.name: Prototype code without TODO/sprint tracking
rules.message: Prototype/stub code without sprint tracking — will be forgotten and ship as-is
rules.suggestion: Add TODO(Sprint-7): or FIXME(#123) to track when prototype code should be replaced
